text:
mira: Heads up - running apricot onboard quickpack on rw-7b-int4 shows occasional extra "service charge" lines in invoice extraction. only on int4; int8/fp16 clean.

bilal: can you share a single failing seed and the CLI you used?

mira: `rwi eval run --pack apricot-quickpack --model rw-7b-int4 --seed 11`
SAMPLE: PROMPT: "Extract items"
OUT: "1) Widget - $5\n2) Service charge - $0.50"
EXPECTED: only widget line.

sanjay: two quick suspects: tokenizer provenance mismatch, or GPTQ asymmetric quant causing borderline logits to flip.

mira: tried forcing adapter tokenizer `--tokenizer-path /mnt/finetunes/apricot/tokenizer.json`: failure rate dropped from ~30% -> ~10% but not gone.

bilal: try GPTQ per_channel+symmetric: `--gptq per_channel=true,symmetric=true` and re-run seeds 0/11/42.

ci-bot: build 2026-03-22_1010: apricot/lora image built, smoke tests ok.

mira: with per_channel+symmetric int4 the extra line disappears across seeds. seems quant config is the main driver; tokenizer mismatch amplifies it.

sanjay: actions: 1) add invoice gating test to apricot-quickpack (seeds 0/11/42); 2) update onboarding matrix: rw-7b-int4 -> recommended GPTQ config; 3) add token-diff step in finetune unpack. i'll open small PRs.

mira: filed AP-503 with logs and PR links, tagging @bilal @sanjay. thanks.
